text:
faye (marketing): Quick thread  rewriting the competitive battlecard to focus on 'unified inference' messaging: predictable SLOs, cost levers, and safe rollouts. Need defensible lines + inbound routing before I publish. Draft: https://redwood-internal/drive/unified-infer-draft

tom (research): Read it. Two asks: (1) change absolute savings to ranges and include a one-line methods footnote, e.g. 'benchmarks run on commit 7f9a; medians reported as p50/p95 across 6 runs', (2) put a tiny reproducibility curl in the footnote so engineers can sanity-check the numbers.

pavel (product): Add a short technical claim: 'policy-driven fallbacks (quantized variants + regional spillover) let you preserve latency SLOs without replatforming models.' Good anti-cloud-API nugget.

juan (growth): Routing + tracking suggestions: primary CTA -> sdr-unified; secondary -> ae-enterprise. UTMs: utm_campaign=unified_launch_q1. Proposed inbound rule (Console JSON):
```json
{ "source":"landing","utm_campaign":"unified_launch_q1","interest":"benchmarks","route":"sdr-unified","priority":25 }
```

Also propose A/B hero lines for the modal: A) "Inference that stays fast in production" B) "Lower token spend, same model fidelity"

claire (sales): SDR openers (short):
- "Hey  saw you checked the unified inference battlecard. is p95 variability a blocker for your app?"
- "Quick q: would a reserved pool with predictable latency help your next pilot?"
Add triage fields: pain=latency|cost|compliance ; scale=dev|pilot|prod

legal-bot: Quick-check: avoid comparatives like 'beats CloudX' or absolutes. Recommend phrasing: 'shows lower median latency in our benchmarks' and keep competitor references generic as 'managed cloud endpoints' unless legal clearance provided.

analytics-bot: FYI: we'll add a tracking dimension 'signup_interest' to GA so growth can segment inbound. Also recommend event 'bench_view' with property 'method_tag' linking to the bench commit.

tom (research): tiny reproducibility snippet for the footnote (one-liner):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v1","input":"hello","max_tokens":64}'
```

pavel (product): Approve the fallback wording but tweak to 'helps meet latency targets under load' instead of 'preserve'.

juan (growth): I'll wire UTMs and GA experiments tonight. Also recommend two email subject lines for the nurture series: 'Benchmarks: who holds latency under load?' and 'Practical levers to cut token spend'.

claire (sales): Procurement one-liner for SDRs: 'Reserved capacity + token-level billing visibility reduces procurement friction for regulated teams.' Adding that to Outreach.

faye (marketing): Thanks. Final checklist: (1) research to add methods line + repo link, (2) product to sign off on final tech sentence, (3) growth to set UTMs + A/B, (4) sales to upload SDR snippets + triage fields. Can we close by 18:00 PT?

tom (research): will push methods blurb and bench repo link by 15:00 PT.

pavel (product): signed off with the wording tweak.

juan (growth): GA + UTMs set by EOD; sharing tracking spreadsheet in drive.

claire (sales): Outreach snippets uploaded and triage fields added by 16:30 PT.

faye (marketing): great. scheduling publish for 2026-01-20T15:00:00Z; leaving thread open for any last micro-copy changes. :rocket:
